name: parallax-layer-stack
title: Parallax Layer Stack
description: Depth from scroll: three planes move at different rates (background 0.3×, mid 0.6×, foreground 1.2×) with depths declared per layer, plus a gentle scale falloff so far planes feel genuinely distant.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Pastel

## Rules

- Scroll Progress Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
